IOTW: if your "moat" was "I really hope smart people don't spend the time and money to build a product as good as ours", you never had a moat, even pre-AI.

AI means everyone can hire L7-tier SWEs to work for them 24/7.

But you could've also hired L7s before. Many obviously did. If that was enough to beat your "moat," it was never a moat.

That's why we don't call just any business advantage a moat. Many businesses have advantages, but few have moats.

thread_tweets.text:
No, my point is that technical moats were a very tiny portion of all moats, and were generally--rightly--regarded by investors with skepticism, even pre-LLMs.

And more importantly, we have not seen *any examples* of technical moats being overturned due to AI. 

We've only seen Twitter demos and hypemaxxing influencers proudly announcing so. Show me a scaled business that has had their technical moat overturned and who overturned it.

This is a very simplistic mental model of AI. The incumbents also have AI, and technical advantages can build upon themselves. Jane Street is now farther ahead of everyone else, ASML is now farther ahead, the labs are now farther ahead. AI is just as likely to deepen technical moats than to flatten them.

That's another weekly close above the May highs now. This was one looks like a perfect run the stops type weekly candle. 

Price action is the truth. You may disagree and have your own narratives (macro doom, Ai doom, bond doom whatever), but if the weekly and monthly candles are telling you it's a bullish trend then just be a respectoooor of the higher time frame trend. 

I think a lot of people are quite confused in regards to Bitcoin's strength vs indexes and gold, and Bitcoin not making sense in respect to their previous mental models of how it should be reacting. 

Markets know more than you, you won't always be able to explain price action, and the reasons for a particular move may reveal themselves at a later date. Usually an asset moving where it is lacking a very obvious catalyst/reason is actually quite bullish.  

I see no reason why BTC doesn't make its way into the 90s at some point in the next few weeks based on the weekly trend. Bulls are in control.

Here’s how you can gain edge by reading between the lines of news and conducting research:

The news: Sui Foundation just wrote a cheque worth $30M into the DATA Network, making it the largest institutional stakeholder in the network.

Here's how I check whether backing like this means anything (steal it)👇 

1. Size it against the asset

> DATA's circulating market cap is around $70M today
> $30M is roughly 40% of that
> You don't commit that much to something you plan to ignore

2: Ask what the investor gets if it works

> Sui has built an AI stack: Walrus for storage, Seal for access control, Nautilus for verifiable compute
> What it needed was a live supply of rights-cleared training data to run through it
> Trace has logged 250M+ data receipts since June. That's the supply
> DATA founder SY Lee also joins Sui Foundation as Strategic Advisor. Both sides are tied in

3: Check who's still holding

> PIP Labs and the DATA Foundation keep their holdings
> Team and early backer unlocks were pushed back 18 months in August
> So the new money arrives while insider supply stays locked

4: Check the demand is real

> Last year one AI lab agreed to pay $1.5B to authors. About $3,000 a book, for training on pirated copies
> The EU AI Act now makes model providers publish a summary of what they trained on, and enforcement powers kicked in this August
> Every lab now needs a paper trail for its data. Trace issues the receipts

In a market that's been brutal on small caps, DATA cut down to one use case and one product in June and kept shipping. Four months later it has the largest institutional stake in the network behind it.

Over the coming months the DATA Network will be upgraded to run natively on Sui, with Walrus as the default storage layer. $DATA stays the token. Nothing changes for holders today.

btw, you should probably run test 1 on the next "strategic partnership" you see and / the cheque by the market cap lmfao.
